name: Idea

---

**The situation in your app**
What you are building and what you currently have to build yourself.

**What you would want to call**
A sketch of the endpoint or the behaviour is enough.

**Why it belongs here and not in your app**
The bar: it should be needed by more than one app, and it should be about
competition, identity, access or trust. Inventory, cloud saves, remote config,
analytics and chat are deliberately out of scope.
